name: 旧更衣柜
prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. A single old steel factory locker, muted teal with chipped cream edge and a replacement handle, three ventilation slits, dented lower door. Closed one-piece door; compact .6x.55tile footprint, body vertical height70px at tile144, grounded feet. NOT huge multi-door wall locker. No labels/text, no powered lighting. Outside silhouette must be fully transparent: no halo, glow, smoky backdrop or drop shadow. Keep large areas of original color; wear only around use points, not everywhere.
